topic: Dizilerden: drama ve suç dizisi dili (günlük kullanımda)

items.example: You should lay low until this blows over.
items.exampleTr: Bu iş geçene kadar ortalarda görünme.
items.simple: Hide and keep quiet so nobody notices you.
dialogue: A: The police are asking about you.
B: Then lay low for a few weeks.
items.note: Breaking Bad'de kaçak ve gizlenme konuşmalarında.

items.example: I promise we will cut someone in if it works.
items.exampleTr: İş yürürse birini ortak edeceğiz, söz.
items.simple: Give someone a share of the money.
dialogue: A: What do I get from this?
B: Maybe we'll cut someone in, but not Lenny.
items.note: Breaking Bad ve Seinfeld'de iş ortaklığı pazarlıklarında.

items.example: I knew the meeting would go off the rails.
items.exampleTr: Toplantının çığrından çıkacağını biliyordum.
items.simple: Things stop going the right way and get wild.
dialogue: A: Will the party be calm?
B: I knew it would go off the rails.
items.note: Breaking Bad ve The Office'te kontrolün kaybedildiği sahnelerde.

items.tr: kontrolsüz, ne yapacağı belli olmayan kişi
items.example: Be careful with Mike. He's a loose cannon.
items.exampleTr: Mike'a dikkat et. Ne yapacağı belli olmaz.
items.simple: A person who might do something crazy at any time.
dialogue: A: Why doesn't the boss trust him?
B: He's a loose cannon.
items.note: Brooklyn Nine-Nine ve Breaking Bad'de.

items.example: Don't throw someone under the bus to save yourself.
items.exampleTr: Kendini kurtarmak için birini harcama.
items.simple: Blame a friend so you don't get in trouble.
dialogue: A: Should I blame Anna?
B: Never throw someone under the bus, Sam.
items.note: The Office ve Modern Family'de ofis/aile ihanetlerinde.

items.example: One more mistake and you're on thin ice.
items.exampleTr: Bir hata daha yaparsan ipin ucunda olursun.
items.simple: You are close to big trouble.
dialogue: A: Am I in trouble?
B: You're on thin ice, my friend.
items.note: Brooklyn Nine-Nine'da kaptanın uyarılarında.

items.example: Watch your back around him. He's sneaky.
items.exampleTr: Onun yanında arkanı kolla. Sinsidir.
items.simple: Be careful because someone may hurt you.
dialogue: A: I'm starting a business with Rick.
B: Watch your back with him.
items.note: Breaking Bad'de tehdit sahnelerinde.

items.example: Learn to cover your tracks, kid.
items.exampleTr: İzlerini kapatmayı öğren evlat.
items.simple: Hide what you did so nobody finds out.
dialogue: A: Why did he wipe his laptop?
B: He had to cover your tracks... I mean, his tracks.
items.note: Breaking Bad ve Brooklyn Nine-Nine'da.

items.example: He'd rat out his own brother for money.
items.exampleTr: Para için kardeşini bile ele verir.
items.simple: Tell on someone to the police or boss.
dialogue: A: Who told the police?
B: I bet someone will rat out the whole gang.
items.note: Breaking Bad ve Brooklyn Nine-Nine'da ihbarcı konuşmalarında.

items.example: Around here, my mother calls the shots.
items.exampleTr: Burada son sözü annem söyler.
items.simple: Be the one who decides what happens.
dialogue: A: Who decides in this house?
B: Mom likes to call the shots.
items.note: Modern Family ve Breaking Bad'de güç mücadelelerinde.

items.example: He gets away with murder because he's charming.
items.exampleTr: Çekici olduğu için yaptığı yanına kalıyor.
items.simple: Do bad things and not get punished.
dialogue: A: Why does the baby never get in trouble?
B: She can get away with murder.
items.note: Malcolm in the Middle ve Seinfeld'de ayrıcalıklı karakterlerde.

items.example: The investigation hit a dead end.
items.exampleTr: Soruşturma çıkmaza girdi.
items.simple: A road or plan that goes nowhere.
dialogue: A: Did the clue lead anywhere?
B: No, it was a dead end.
items.note: Brooklyn Nine-Nine'da vaka çözümlerinde.

items.example: Somebody had to cook the books to hide the cash.
items.exampleTr: Parayı gizlemek için birinin hesaplarla oynaması gerekti.
items.simple: Change money records to fool people.
dialogue: A: Why don't the numbers match?
B: Somebody decided to cook the books.
items.note: The Office'te Oscar/muhasebe olaylarında, Breaking Bad'de.

items.example: Let me tie up a few loose ends before I go.
items.exampleTr: Gitmeden bazı açık işleri bitireyim.
items.simple: Finish the small jobs that are still not done.
dialogue: A: Are you leaving the case?
B: Soon, once I tie up loose ends.
items.note: Breaking Bad ve Brooklyn Nine-Nine'da.

items.example: I'll take the heat if the plan fails.
items.exampleTr: Plan başarısız olursa sorumluluğu ben alırım.
items.simple: Get the anger or blame so others are safe.
dialogue: A: The boss will be furious.
B: I'll take the heat for this one.
items.note: Brooklyn Nine-Nine'da takım içinde.

items.example: I think you're in over your head with this loan.
items.exampleTr: Bence bu krediyle altından kalkamayacağın işe girdin.
items.simple: The problem is too big for you.
dialogue: A: I started three businesses.
B: You're in over your head.
items.note: Breaking Bad ve The Big Bang Theory'de.

items.example: Someone wanted to set someone up as the thief.
items.exampleTr: Biri hırsız gibi göstermek için birini tuzağa düşürmek istedi.
items.simple: Trick someone so they get blamed.
dialogue: A: The evidence was in his bag.
B: Maybe they wanted to set someone up.
items.note: Brooklyn Nine-Nine ve Breaking Bad'de komplo sahnelerinde.

items.example: I'd never double-cross a friend.
items.exampleTr: Bir arkadaşımı asla arkadan vurmam.
items.simple: Be false to a person who trusts you.
dialogue: A: Can I trust him?
B: Not if he decides to double-cross you.
items.note: Breaking Bad'de ortaklık ihanetlerinde.

items.example: He's been living off the grid for years.
items.exampleTr: Yıllardır iz bırakmadan yaşıyor.
items.simple: Living where nobody can find or follow you.
dialogue: A: Where's your cousin these days?
B: Off the grid, in a cabin.
items.note: Breaking Bad'de kaçış ve saklanma sahnelerinde.

items.example: Don't sign anything. We don't want a paper trail.
items.exampleTr: Hiçbir şey imzalama. Yazılı iz bırakmayalım.
items.simple: Papers that show what someone did.
dialogue: A: Should we email the details?
B: No, it leaves a paper trail.
items.note: Breaking Bad ve The Office'te.

items.tr: iki tarafı da oynamak, ikili oynamak
items.example: He's playing both sides, so trust nobody.
items.exampleTr: İki tarafa da oynuyor, kimseye güvenme.
items.simple: Pretend to help two groups who fight each other.
dialogue: A: Is he with us or them?
B: He likes to play both sides.
items.note: Breaking Bad'de çifte oyun oynayan karakterlerde.

items.example: Sooner or later, you'll pay the price for lying.
items.exampleTr: Er geç yalanın bedelini ödersin.
items.simple: Get a bad result because of your actions.
dialogue: A: Nobody saw me do it.
B: You'll pay the price eventually.
items.note: Breaking Bad'de sonuçlar ve cezalarda.

items.example: After the move, he wanted a clean slate.
items.exampleTr: Taşındıktan sonra temiz bir sayfa istiyordu.
items.simple: A fresh start with old mistakes forgotten.
dialogue: A: Why did you change cities?
B: I needed a clean slate.
items.note: Brooklyn Nine-Nine ve Friends'te yeni başlangıçlarda.

items.example: The boss turned a blind eye to the cheating.
items.exampleTr: Patron hileye göz yumdu.
items.simple: Know about something wrong and not stop it.
dialogue: A: Why didn't he report it?
B: He'd rather turn a blind eye.
items.note: Brooklyn Nine-Nine ve Breaking Bad'de.

items.example: She paid hush money to keep it secret.
items.exampleTr: Sır kalsın diye sus payı verdi.
items.simple: Money you give so someone stays quiet.
dialogue: A: Why is he so quiet about it?
B: I think he got hush money.
items.note: Breaking Bad ve Seinfeld'de.

items.example: Don't burn bridges when you quit your job.
items.exampleTr: İşten ayrılırken köprüleri atma.
items.simple: Make people so angry they won't help you again.
dialogue: A: Should I tell my boss what I think?
B: Don't burn bridges, you may need him.
items.note: The Office'te istifa bölümlerinde.
